# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
## FORM DESIGN: PASS
## NAVIGATION: PASS
## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
## CONSISTENCY: PASS
## MINIMALISM: PASS

## Additional Issues Found:

[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Low] [WCAG 2.2 AA] "PLAYERONE" text in header has insufficient contrast | Impact: Users with visual impairments may struggle to read the current user name | Fix: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA (≥4.5:1) by adjusting color or adding text shadow: `color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);`

[ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: Low] [Nielsen's Heuristics] "Create Custom" button has inconsistent capitalization | Impact: Minor inconsistency breaks design pattern recognition | Fix: Standardize to "Create Custom" or "Create custom" throughout interface

[ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: Low] [Laws of UX] "Trending Modpacks" section lacks visual separation from main content | Impact: Users may not immediately recognize this as a distinct section | Fix: Add subtle divider or increased margin: `margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);`

[ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Low] [Aesthetic-Usability Effect] Empty state message uses passive voice | Impact: Less engaging user experience | Fix: Change to active voice: "Click 'New Modpack' to create your first modpack" instead of "Click + New Modpack to create one"

[ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Low] [Fitts's Law] "Show all" button in Vanilla Versions section is small and distant | Impact: Reduced click efficiency for users | Fix: Increase size and proximity: `padding: 0.4rem 1rem; margin-left: 1rem;`

All critical accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.2 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, focus management) appear to be met. The interface demonstrates strong visual hierarchy, consistent design patterns, and clear interactive feedback.
